description: This file defines a PhotosHandler class for handling photo retrieval in an Android app, including permission checks, querying media store for recent images, resizing, encoding them, and returning a JSON payload with photo data.

classes.name: PhotosLatestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for latest photos with limit, maxWidth, and quality parameters.

classes.name: EncodedPhotoPayload
classes.description: Data class representing an encoded photo including format, base64 string, dimensions, and creation date.

classes.name: PhotosDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission check and fetching latest photos.

classes.name: SystemPhotosDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing PhotosDataSource, retrieves photos from device storage.

classes.name: PhotosHandler
classes.description: Main class handling photo requests, permissions, querying media store, processing images, and generating JSON responses.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest
methods.description: Handles request to fetch latest photos, verifies permission, parses request, fetches data, and returns JSON result or error.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a PhotosLatestRequest object with default and validated values.

methods.name: queryLatestRows
methods.description: Queries the MediaStore for the latest images up to a limit, returning list of PhotoRow objects.

methods.name: decodeScaledBitmap
methods.description: Decodes and scales a bitmap from a URI within specified max width.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Computes inSampleSize for bitmap decoding to optimize memory usage.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a bitmap to JPEG with specified quality, ensuring base64 size remains within budget.
